```{r}
library(anndataR)
ref_ad <- read_h5ad(
    "2.5_car_no_gd.h5ad"
)

query_ad <- read_h5ad(
    "3_carpallcohort3_clustered.h5ad"
)
```

```{r}
ref <- ref_ad$as_Seurat(reduction_mapping = list(pca=c(key="PC_", embeddings = "X_pca", loadings = "PCs"), umap = c(key="UMAP_", embeddings = "X_umap")))
query <- query_ad$as_Seurat(reduction_mapping = list(pca=c(key="PC_", embeddings = "X_pca", loadings = "PCs"), umap = c(key="UMAP_", embeddings = "X_umap")))
```

```{r}
ref <- FindVariableFeatures(ref)
```

```{r}
ref[["RNA"]]$data <- LayerData(
    ref,
    assay = "RNA",
    layer = "logcounts"
)

query[["RNA"]]$data <- LayerData(
    query,
    assay = "RNA",
    layer = "logcounts"
)
```

```{r}
Layers(ref[["RNA"]])
Layers(query[["RNA"]])
```

```{r}
anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
    reference = ref,
    query = query,
    features = VariableFeatures(ref),
    reference.reduction = "X_pca",
    reduction = "pcaproject",
    dims = 1:30
)
```
